scope: Single feasibility check of a proposed training weight, DS1 only. Previously inspected development tasks. No model fitted; no policy promotion.
sample: All 26 tasks; fixed original pool_id=0, both archived repeats. Each accepted first unique unordered pair with distinct execution scores. No sampling by result.
method: Exact actual C0 replay. In two continuations separately force this edge to the higher/lower execution-utility candidate; retain original confidence, gate, initial seed, remaining bank and original query cap. Compare terminal normalized regret wrong minus right; check prefix and identity, and exact original branch. Use label only for training-signal design/diagnosis.
predictions_and_stop: Terminal effect need not coincide with normalized score gap. Check signs including zero, and whether the same pair at the same pool/gap has different effects across the two repeats. Predefine example as lexicographically first recurring (task,pair) with such a difference. End after this check. Evidence of a varying supervision signal, not proof of generalization or winning training method.
